title: OpenAI's new AI runs 14 times faster than the current version
title_candidates: OpenAI's new AI runs 14 times faster than the current version
The version of GPT-5 that barely pauses before it answers
How OpenAI got their AI to respond 14 times faster
GPT-5.6 Sol is the fastest AI OpenAI has ever shipped
The version of ChatGPT most people still can't get into
caption:
OpenAI just previewed GPT-5.6 Sol, a new ultrafast mode that runs up to 14 times the speed of the current model. That gap between typing a question and reading an answer is about to feel very different.

It's rolling out to API developers first, with broader access coming as capacity grows. The crowd reaction says it all: people are already asking whether the $200 plan gets them in, or if this is another feature that lives behind a wall most users never reach.
